description: The bar chart, titled "% point difference" and associated with the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," compares the performance difference between two models—mBERT (light blue) and XLM-R (dark blue)—across three distinct experimental conditions. The horizontal axis displays these conditions: "hidden:[50], linear," "hidden:[100], ReLU," and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU." The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference, ranging from -0.2 to 0.2. For the first condition, "hidden:[50], linear," mBERT shows a large negative difference (approximately -0.18), while XLM-R shows a small positive difference (approximately 0.02). In the second condition, "hidden:[100], ReLU," mBERT has a positive difference (approximately 0.08), and XLM-R has a slightly positive difference (approximately 0.03). For the third condition, "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU," mBERT shows a negative difference (approximately -0.16), and XLM-R shows a more negative difference (approximately -0.12). The legend in the top-right corner identifies the light blue bars as mBERT and the dark blue bars as XLM-R.
